collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — RELATIONSHIPS, SINGLEHOOD AND FAMILY (FAM2-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Couples of every kind, courting, quarrels, separations without blame, widowhood and second loves, happily single and childfree villagers, single parents, grandparents, siblings, chosen and extended families, and affection that isn't romantic. Nobody has to love, marry or have children, everyone may say no to affection, and a player's choice never obliges a villager to anything.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: Two grown siblings sit together without talking, and someone asks if they have fallen out: explain, or just laugh.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) are siblings, grown now, living in different huts. They don't talk much when they see each other. They just sit together on the same rock where they used to sit as children, and watch the sea, and sometimes one of them hands the other a piece of fruit. (villager), a villager who doesn't know them very well, asks (subject) whether they've fallen out.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Oh, no," says (subject). "We just don't need to talk. We already know what the other one's going to say." (villager) looks confused. (subject) smiles. "It's hard to explain. When you've known someone your whole life, sometimes sitting together is the whole conversation." (villager) goes away still confused. (subject) and (friend) go back to watching the sea.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) laughs. "Fallen out? We've barely said a word to each other in years!" (villager) looks alarmed. (subject) waves (subject.his/her) hand. "No, no. That's how we are. We like it." The next day (subject) tells (friend) about it, and (friend) laughs so hard (friend.he/she) nearly falls off the rock. That's the most either of them has said in weeks.
